description: You are a Spatial Data Engineer configuring GeoServer to publish filtered geospatial features via WFS. Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!). Complete all of the following: (1) In the WFS global service settings, ensure WFS is enabled, set the service title to 'Natural Earth WFS', and set the maximum number of features to 5000. (2) In the 'ne' workspace using its existing PostGIS datastore, create a new SQL view named 'major_cities' using the query: SELECT * FROM ne_populated_places WHERE pop_max > 1000000 — with geometry column 'wkb_geometry', type Point, SRID 4326 — and publish it as a layer in the 'ne' workspace. (3) Create an SLD style named 'city_marker' with a circle mark, red fill (#FF0000), size 8 pixels. Apply 'city_marker' as the default style for ne:major_cities.
